title: Wire renderer data operations through supabase-data.js in Electron mode
context: Issue #277-D of the #277 S2-hybrid migration. Routes all renderer data operations through src/js/supabase-data.js (supabase-js + anon key, RLS-enforced) when running in Electron, while leaving the server/browser mode path (apiFetch → server.py) completely unchanged. isElectronMode() from auth-ui.js gates each call site.

not_tested: MANUAL SMOKE REQUIRED — open project loads via Supabase REST (not /api/projects): verify in browser Network tab that opening a project in Electron makes a POST to supabase.co/rest/v1/projects, not /api/projects.
MANUAL SMOKE REQUIRED — save round-trip: edit bulletin text + save; confirm row appears in Supabase projects table with updated state JSONB.
MANUAL SMOKE REQUIRED — transfer works: requires 277-B transfer_project_owner RPC to be deployed to the Supabase project.
MANUAL SMOKE REQUIRED — presence badge: open same project as two users; confirm the second user sees '● [user] is editing' badge. Requires live Supabase session.

MANUAL SMOKE REQUIRED — PDF still works: PDF generation still goes through /api/pdf (Python sidecar + Chrome) in Electron mode — it is NOT routed through Supabase. Confirm PDF export works after this change.
MANUAL SMOKE REQUIRED — delete announcement actually removes it: verify that deleting an announcement in Electron mode removes it from the announcements table (full-replace via delete-then-insert).
MANUAL SMOKE REQUIRED — settings merge (staff, calendar Drive folder): save staff data, reload app, confirm staff data persists in workspace_settings.settings JSONB.

LIMITATION (deferred to #216): saveProjectToServer in Electron mode does NOT create project_revisions snapshots. The comment '// TODO(#216): revision snapshot handled by DB trigger' is in place. Until the #216 DB trigger lands, revision history will not accumulate for Electron-mode saves.

LIMITATION: sdGetPresence TTL filter (90 seconds) is applied client-side (filter rows by last_seen_at >= now()-90s) rather than at the DB level. This matches the server's 90s window semantically but wastes one round-trip row if stale rows exist.

LIMITATION: Announcement full-replace uses sb.from('announcements').delete().not('id','is',null) to delete all workspace-scoped rows before re-inserting. RLS must scope the delete correctly (workspace_id = auth.uid()'s workspace). If RLS does not include a workspace_id delete policy, this step will silently delete nothing. Verify RLS policies allow DELETE on announcements for the workspace owner/members.

LIMITATION: Settings merge (read-then-write) in staff.js saveStaffData() and calendar.js saveDriveFolderId() has a TOCTOU race if two concurrent saves happen simultaneously — the second read may get stale data and overwrite the first save. Acceptable for single-user Electron mode.

LIMITATION: volunteer-roles.js, templates.js, editor.js, state.js, pco.js, app.js settings saves are NOT routed through supabase-data.js yet (those files are outside the 277-D permitted edit scope). They will still call apiFetch('/api/settings',...) in Electron mode. These are follow-up work.

LIMITATION: handleHandoff members fetch in Electron mode does not filter out the current user. All workspace members are returned; the UI shows all. The server-side handler excludes self — minor UX gap in Electron mode.

LIMITATION: sdSaveSettings requires workspace_id for the upsert ON CONFLICT; if workspace_id is null (user metadata not populated), the upsert may fail with a constraint violation. Confirm workspace_id is set in user.user_metadata.workspace_id after provision_first_login.
